manual_release_gates.detail: No wiki upload/push is authorized in this review. Local routes do not establish that the official site or pipeline is deployed; verify the final main pipeline and standard URLs before freeze.

The official 2026 requirement is source-built CI with pinned dependencies and no hand-uploaded compiled output. Hand-authored HTML is valid source; build-publication.py generates its standard routes. Confirm that CI also rebuilds generated homepage bundles/game output from their retained sources and preserves the root LICENSE.
Check the official submitted Attributions, Judging and Safety forms, Registry entries and deliverable state. A local iframe or narrative does not prove a form is complete or submitted.

The user identified the tools as chatgpt-6 astra, claude opus 5.5 and fable 5.1, and confirmed review by team members. Treat these as team-declared names, not independently verified vendor/version identifiers. Each scientific claim, citation and calculation still needs defensible source evidence.

Verified cover illustrations now show the known OpenAI image-generation tool family and CC BY 4.0 next to the image. Individual image-model/version records remain unconfirmed; do not assign the declared language models to these pictures. Third-party images/logos/fonts still require redistribution/modification rights and source/license next to the asset. A central credits page alone does not satisfy the inline attribution rule.

Validate each numerical claim against raw records, sample units, controls and uncertainty; verify citations and quoted stakeholder statements. Editorial removal of negative wording must not convert unmeasured or preliminary work into a completed result.

Final award eligibility depends on the Judging Form selections; at most three elective awards, covering both General Bio Engineering and Specialization. Do not infer the selections from the presence of pages.
A Video Universe URL is not proof of approved public playback. Confirm each video after transcoding and moderation. Edit an existing video rather than uploading duplicates.

official_sources.scope: 2026 NTHU official wiki requirements read directly from the signed-in dashboard.
rules: Runtime assets and requests must stay on iGEM domains; ordinary outbound scholarly links are permitted.
Source, CI configuration and locked dependencies must reproduce the wiki.
Content CC BY 4.0, preserved root LICENSE, inline third-party and AI-image attribution.
Fixed judging URLs and visible GitLab footer link.
Real evidence/citations and transparent AI model, purpose and human review disclosure.
Use Video Universe for video/audio; moderator approval is required for public playback.
Avoid duplicate uploads; edit existing video details.
Include wiki URL, appropriate category, Attribution license, narration language or No linguistic content, Public, no sensitive content, publish after transcoding.
Best Wiki assesses clear goals, convincing evidence, usable navigation, durable documentation and citation quality.
Hardware evidence includes utility, user feedback and reproducibility; Model evidence includes data grounding and design relevance.
Best Software needs an OSI license and dedicated iGEM GitLab source repository.
Judge claims against measured/modeled evidence, engineering decisions, integrated Human Practices, documented components and student leadership.
Wiki, Judging Form, Attributions Form, Registry and Software list October 21; Presentation Video lists October 28. Exact deadline time must be checked on the dashboard.
